description: Check whether an address holds a recognised member NFT and what it gets. Members pay ZERO on cross-chain transfers of $0.10-$25 to low-cost chains, 15bps instead of 25bps routing, and 10% instead of 25% gas markup. Read-only. Call this before quoting for a user so you can tell them accurately what a transfer will cost — and, if they are not a member, what holding a recognised NFT would save them.
name: robyn_vip_status
title: Check membership / VIP benefits for an address
